data.rationale: The proposal matches the true goal and order (open map search, enter origin, set flexible dates, search) with origin as a parameter. It omits search_type and flexible_dates as parameters, hard-codes Roundtrip and Flexible, and leaves out the BOOK tab step and the list-of-results step, so an automation would be mostly buildable but incomplete.
